title: Expanding a JWT user-permission template that references a non-existent tag panics with an out-of-range slice access ...

source.license_note: Real upstream nats PR #4730; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: Expanding a JWT user-permission template that references a non-existent tag panics with an out-of-range slice access instead of returning an error.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the server package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: processUserPermissionsTemplate reads valueList[0] without checking the slice length, so an empty cartesian-product value list (produced when a template references a missing tag) triggers an index-out-of-range panic.

ops_fault.description: Processing a JWT user-permission template that mixes a non-existent tag with a valid tag crashes the server with an index out of range panic.
localization_keywords: missing tag yields empty token substitution
repair_keywords: skip substitution when no tag values remain
fall through to else when value list is empty

visible_context.issue_text: A scoped user JWT whose permission template references a tag that does not exist (followed by a valid tag) causes the server to panic while expanding the template instead of rejecting the template with an error.
error_logs: panic: runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0
authorization failed: panic recovered while expanding JWT permission template
visible_context.notes: Real upstream regression; diagnosis injected as upstream ops context.
